criteria.criterion: `ac-satisfiability` is a registered plan-review criterion routed as `exec: "1-TURN"`, `facet: "coherence"`, `default_posture: "advisory"`; verified by `pytest tests/unit/test_ac_satisfiability_criterion.py::test_routing_entry` and by `validate_packaged_routing()` returning an empty list.

Its rubric states the set-quantification primitive and names all three contradiction shapes (universal-vs-carve-out, derived-artifact closure, snapshot cardinality), and does not reference the `Success Criteria` migration that motivated it; verified by `pytest tests/unit/test_ac_satisfiability_criterion.py::test_rubric_is_generic`.

The criterion is exercised end to end through the Pass-1 single-turn chunk path against a `FakeRunner`, and a finding it emits survives attribution validation; verified by `pytest tests/unit/test_ac_satisfiability_criterion.py::test_reaches_pass1_and_attributes`.

`explain_criterion("ac-satisfiability")` returns the criterion's non-empty guide section rather than raising `ExplainError`; verified by `pytest tests/unit/test_ac_satisfiability_criterion.py::test_explain_returns_section`.

criteria.criterion: Nothing under `src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/` changes, because Pass-2's `internal_conflict` axis already grades this defect; verified by `git diff --exit-code origin/main -- src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/` exiting 0.
The sibling roster carries each child's acceptance-criteria items, not only ids and titles; verified by `pytest tests/unit/test_container_roster.py::test_roster_carries_child_ac`.

All three non-test callers of `pass1_container` (`pass1.py`, `fidelity_spot_eval.py`, `eval_solver.py`) obtain the roster from the single shared `build_sibling_roster` helper, and none retains its own roster-building expression; verified by `pytest tests/unit/test_container_roster.py::test_roster_builder_single_sourced`.
`eval_solver`'s `sibling_roster` fixture override still takes precedence over the shared builder; verified by `pytest tests/unit/test_container_roster.py::test_eval_fixture_roster_override_wins`.

The rendered roster places each child's acceptance-criteria items indented beneath that child's `- <id>: <title>` line, and a child with no parseable criteria keeps its line alone; verified by `pytest tests/unit/test_container_roster.py::test_roster_render_format`.

A child description with no `## Acceptance Criteria` section, and a parent with no children, each produce a roster without raising; verified by `pytest tests/unit/test_container_roster.py::test_roster_degrades_gracefully`.
`G3`'s rubric instructs the reviewer to test "no sibling covers it" against the roster's acceptance criteria; verified by `pytest tests/unit/test_container_roster.py::test_g3_rubric_cites_roster_ac`.

The container pass sends the roster inside its system prompt and not inside its per-pairing instructions; verified by `pytest tests/unit/test_container_roster.py::test_roster_rides_prefix_not_instructions`.

The roster's token cost is included in the `parent_tokens` prefix estimate that feeds container bin-packing and the warm gate; verified by `pytest tests/unit/test_container_roster.py::test_roster_counted_in_prefix_estimate`.
`G3`'s `default_posture` and `block_threshold` are unchanged from their pre-change values; verified by `pytest tests/unit/test_container_roster.py::test_g3_posture_unchanged`.
`docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md` parity-checks clean against the registry; verified by `validate_criteria_guide()` returning an empty list.
No `src/rebar/**/*.py` file exceeds the 800-LOC cap; verified by `pytest tests/unit/test_module_size_contract.py`.
